name: Short-Cut Spanakopita with Greek Tomato-Cucumber Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small bunches fresh dill
3 tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice ⅓ of the onions; transfer to a large bowl. Add vinegar and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp red wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the minced onion and cook, stirring often, until softened, 5-6 minutes. Transfer to a separate, large bowl. Save skillet for later use.

When the water in the pot comes to a boil, remove lid, add the spinach and stir for a few seconds. Cook the spinach, uncovered, until wilted, 30-60 seconds. Once done, drain the spinach in a colander and rinse under cold water.
Shave parsley and dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add both to the bowl with the cooked onion.
Grate the cheddar and add to the bowl with the cooked onion.

Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and add to the bowl with the cooked onion. Add feta, oil, and spices to the bowl and mix with your hands to thoroughly combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the pies, lay the tortillas on a flat surface and divide the spinach mixture between them; press the mixture firmly onto one half of each tortilla; fold in half.

Wipe the skillet clean and return to medium heat. Add oil and swirl to coat. Cooking in batches if necessary, lay the assembled pies in the pan. Cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from the heat and slice into wedges.
Meanwhile, cut the tomatoes into wedges. Peel and trim the ends of the cucumbers, then thinly slice into rounds. Add to the bowl with the sliced onion.
Add olives, oil, and spices to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide spinach pie and cucumber-tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!
